manifest.controls: All methods use identical threshold search, signed-literal hmax, BFS <=64 nodes/query and <=4096 nodes/run. leaf is certified resource-blind pair incompatibility plus a valid clique and binary leaf count. pair is completed exact 1/2-world policy projections; interrupted queries are omitted. Information control allows 150000 work charges/run. Counts/lineage retain same projection and resource keys; relation cap 100000. Unconditional capacity budget 3 seconds/run, <=1 second/query. Scheduled capacity uses min(3s,0.25s+0.25*noncapacity elapsed) credit, <=0.25s/query; skips singleton queries. Checkpoint deadlines can overrun by one atomic SAT query.
manifest.scope: 26 new public originals, 8 explicit resource overlays, 5 separately labelled old failures. No new-instance planner outcomes inspected before freezing implementation and this manifest. All unsupported syntax/enumeration/grounding cases remain in the denominator and are reported separately. 60-step bound is declared, not a claim of unrestricted infeasibility. No LLM calls.
